Title: Use Azure Key Vault-managed client certificates in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
Microsoft is working to expand the ability to use Azure Key Vault-managed SSL certificates for custom domain names in API Management to mutual certificate authentication between the API gateway and a back end system.

To vote and share your thoughts on this development, please see Use Azure Key Vault-managed client certificates in Azure API Management.
